title: fileenrich action
description: Replaces the body with the content of the first file (by name) in a directory that the options select; without one the message passes on unchanged. Sets file.name and Content-Type.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Only the file with this name; "" for any

include.title: Include
include.description: Regular expression the file name must match; "" for any

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Regular expression the file name must not match; "" for none

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Keep the content as bytes instead of text

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Charset of the file: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: Delete the file once it is read; otherwise it stays

autoCreate.title: Create directory
autoCreate.description: Accepted for compatibility; a missing directory holds no files

maxMessagesPerPoll.title: Files per poll
maxMessagesPerPoll.description: Accepted for compatibility; one file enriches the message
